name: eclipse-muster
summary: Eclipse Muster MCP — the Customer Graph core of the Eclipse customer adapter family: canonical Person/Company/Deal/Ticket/Conversation/Activity records with per-field provenance and Data Rights Ledgers, propose-only identity merges, field-level egress masking, records-only reply drafts, and a hash-chained, content-free receipt ledger.
